title: Places
subtitle: Homework · Gateway A2, Unit 1 · группа 7.3. About 20 minutes. Блок 4 — уровень B1+. В конце получаешь устное задание.
reportTitle: ДЗ Gateway A2 U1 «Places in Town» · группа 7.3

intros.d: Where are you? Look at the picture and choose the right place.
Look at the picture. Tap the letters in the right order. There are two extra letters!
First match the pairs, then write the missing words.
Последний блок, самый сложный. Когда именно: at, on, in — и их друзья by, until, since, for, during.

mc.f: You watch a new film here on a very big screen.
You borrow books here and return them a few weeks later.
This is the place to learn about history and the past.
It's green and outside. People walk their dogs here.
Thousands of people sit here and watch a football match.
You swim 25 metres here and the water smells of chlorine.
People eat a meal here, sometimes on special occasions.
A lot of shops in one big building — you come here to buy clothes.

pairs: a place by the sea where boats stay
the building where the local government works
a shop where you buy medicine
an area with swings and slides for children
a large open area in the centre of a town
a building where an orchestra performs

ty.s: The boats stay in the ___ all winter.
I need some medicine, so I'm going to the ___.
My little brother loves the ___ in the park.
We met in the main ___, next to the fountain.
There are thirty paintings in that art ___.
In winter we skate at the ice ___.

prep.s: The lesson starts ___ half past eight.
prep.f: A point on the clock → AT.
A date or a day → ON.
A long stretch of time → IN.

prep.s: I have been waiting here ___ two o'clock.
prep.f: SINCE + the moment it started. FOR + how long.

prep.s: We waited outside the cinema ___ twenty minutes.

prep.f: DURING + an event. (WHILE needs a verb: while the concert was on.)

prep.s: I'll be home ___ seven, I promise.
prep.f: BY = not later than seven. UNTIL = the action lasts up to seven.
last / next / this / every take NO preposition.

mission.intro: Твои ответы уже у учителя. Теперь настоящая домашка. Она одинаковая для всех — и она устная.

blocks.p: Next lesson you speak for 60–90 seconds about your week in this town: which places you go to and when. Hide ONE lie inside. The class asks questions and tries to find it.
blocks.ru: Рассказываешь про свою неделю: куда и когда ходишь. Одно событие — выдумка. Класс ищет её вопросами.

check.ru: I go to the pool at six, on Tuesdays, in the evening.
I have been going to that gym for two years.
I stay at the library until seven. / I have to be home by nine.
During the holidays I go to the ice rink every day.

check.t: one sentence with NO preposition: last / next / every
check.ru: Last Saturday I went to the market.

check.t: two B1+ places (aquarium, castle, market, concert hall, ice rink, skate park, bowling alley, cathedral…)

blocks.h: The rules that kill the mistakes
blocks.p:
on last Friday ✗   last Friday ✓
during two hours ✗   for two hours ✓
I will wait by six ✗   I will wait until six ✓
in the morning, but on Friday morning.

blocks.h: How to prepare: speak, don't write
ol: Say your week out loud 3 times. Record yourself on your phone if you like — it's only for you.
Make a card with max 5 keywords (no sentences!). Only this card is allowed in class.
Be ready: a partner will fill in your timetable while you speak, and the teacher will ask 2 surprise questions (“Since when? Until what time?”).
blocks.ru: ИИ напишет текст за 5 секунд, но не ответит за тебя на неожиданный вопрос. Готовься говорить сам.

blocks.model: On Mondays I go to the gym at four — I have been going there since September. On Wednesday evening we usually go to the cinema, and the film never finishes before ten, so I get home at about half past. I don't do anything on Tuesday. <mark>Every Thursday I play the piano in the concert hall until midnight.</mark> At the weekend it's better: on Saturday morning my mum and I go to the market for an hour, and in the afternoon I'm at the ice rink. During the holidays I go there every day. Last Sunday I was at the museum for three hours.

blocks.p: No notes. Just you, your 5 keywords and your English.
